headline: Gives the Department of Health and Human Services special contracting powers for national defense work.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 10789, which lets certain federal agencies use special contracting powers when the work helps national defense. It adds the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to the agencies that may use these powers. The title does not give details on how HHS would use them.

who_it_affects.group: Department of Health and Human Services
who_it_affects.how: HHS gains the authority to use certain special contracting powers for national defense work.
Businesses working with HHS on defense-related projects may be offered contracts under these special powers.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 20, 2001; no separate effective date is given in the title.
